packages.label: הַלֵּב, יִרְאָה, תְּפִלָּה, נְבוּאָה וְשׁוֹפָר
packages.label_en: The Heart, Fear, Prayer, Prophecy, and Shofar
packages.reason: This is the Torah's central thematic cluster of holy concepts. The heart (lev) is the seat of fear (yirah), which is the essence of Jerusalem. The shofar embodies all the major concepts simultaneously: it IS the heart, it IS fear, it IS prophecy, and it IS prayer. Prayer is the aspect of Dvar Hashem (the Divine Word), which is the root of all healing power. Prophecy redeems prayer. The Mashiach is the nose (chotem) that receives the scents/prayers. The ba'al tefilla (prayer master) is the great lender from whom all heavenly hosts borrow. All these concepts share the same essential nature as expressions of holy service flowing through the heart.
merge_notes: Merged Component 4 (שלש מדות / שלש משמרות / אנשי שם): The three desires (mamon, achilah, mishgal) ARE the three watches AND the 'men of name'. The concept 'שלש מדות' refers to the same three desires already in this package. 'אנשי שם' = each desire is called a 'shem'. The identity is explicit bechina in the text.
Merged Component 9 (חמור נוער / תאות ממון): chamor noer IS ta'avat mamon (first watch = desire for money). ta'avat mamon is an alias for ממון already in this component.
Merged Component 11 (כלבים צועקים / תאות אכילה): klavim IS ta'avat achilah (second watch = desire for food). ta'avat achilah is an alias for אכילה already in this component.

Merged Component 10 (לילה / חשך): Night/darkness = the three watches = the obstacles to the heart. The text explicitly equates לילה = חשך = מניעות, and the three watches ARE the three desires, linking directly to שלש מדות and הלב.

packages.label: שָׁרְשֵׁי הַנְּשָׁמוֹת וְכִסֵּא הַכָּבוֹד
packages.label_en: Soul Roots and the Throne of Glory
packages.reason: This cluster concerns the foundational concept of connecting to the roots of all Jewish souls, which are hewn from beneath the Throne of Glory. The Throne = Chava (Eve) = 'Mother of all living' = the Tzela (rib). By grasping these soul-roots, one gains the power to rule over angels and becomes 'the place of the world'. The memshala (rulership) concept (teki'ah = yated = memshala) is the direct outcome of this soul-root connection.
merge_notes: Merged Component 7 (ממשלה / ותקעתיו יתד / תקעו): Rulership (memshala) is the direct goal of connecting to soul roots. 'ותקעתיו יתד במקום נאמן' IS memshala, and 'תקעו' in the psalm IS memshala. The Torah explicitly states that through grasping the kisei hakavod/shorshei haneshamot, one gains memshala over angels. The shared nature: all express the concept of being 'established' through soul-root connection.

packages.label: דַּעַת וְשָׁלֹשׁ רְגָלִים
packages.reason: Da'at (knowledge) IS the three brains (tlat mochin), which ARE the three festivals. Each festival IS a renewal of the mind (hitchadshut hamochin). The 'chodesh' (month/renewal) in the psalm IS this renewal. These form a self-contained domain about the cognitive-spiritual mechanism that repairs the three evil desires.
merge_notes: Merged Components 5 and 6: Component 5 (hitchadshut hamochin / bachodesh / regel) and Component 6 (daat / tlat mochin / shalosh regalim) share the same thematic domain of cognitive renewal through the festivals. The text presents them as one continuous argument: Daat = tlat mochin = shalosh regalim, and each regel = hitchadshut hamochin. Although they are separate connected components in the strict graph, the alias 'regalim' in Component 6 and 'regel' in Component 5 refer to the same concept, justifying the merge.

packages.label: שָׁלֹשׁ עֲבוֹדוֹת דְּסִטְרָא אָחֳרָא
packages.label_en: Three Evil Services of the Other Side
packages.reason: The three evil traits — contempt for others (bizui), idolatry/flawed faith (avodah zara), and sexual immorality (pgam habrit) — are all equated with 'servitude' (avdut). They are the mirror-image of holy service (avodat Hashem = tefilla). Each IS a form of servitude to the sitra achra, and they damage the ability to pray. This is the evil mirror of the prayer/service domain in Package 1.

packages.label: נְשִׂיאוּת חֵן
packages.reason: Nesi'ut chen (carrying grace) IS the quality of Esther — each person sees the ba'al tefilla as their own nation. This is a distinct bechina pair about the charismatic quality that emerges from the prayer master's connection to the divine root. While thematically related to the prayer domain, the bechina relationship is specifically between the abstract quality (nesi'ut chen) and its biblical embodiment (Esther).
merge_notes: Considered merging into Package 1 (Prayer), since nesi'ut chen is described as a quality of the ba'al tefilla. However, the text connects the ba'al tefilla to chen via cause-and-effect (eitza), not bechina. The ba'al tefilla PRODUCES nesi'ut chen through being the root of all powers; chen is a RESULT, not a shared nature. Kept separate per the bechina-only grouping rule.

good_evil_mirror.description: The Torah's polarity structure centers on the heart (lev) as the point of fracture.

mirrors.good: Package 1 (Heart/Fear/Prayer) - holy yirah residing in the lev, prayer as dvar Hashem
mirrors.evil: Package 1 also contains the three desires (mamon, achilah, mishgal) which DESTROY the heart/yirah. The heart is the shared battleground. Package 4 (Three Evil Services) damages prayer from the outside.

mirrors.good: Package 3 (Daat/Festivals) - the repair mechanism for the three desires
mirrors.evil: The three desires and three watches (in Package 1) are the disorder that daat/festivals repair
